y-m-50-04.title: Idan aikin haɗaka ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, ayyukan biyu ma ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne?
y-m-50-04.topic: Abin da za mu iya faɗa game da f da g idan aikin haɗaka g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne
y-m-50-04.goal: Nemo ƙimomin aikin haɗaka kai tsaye daga teburin da aka bayar domin gwada ikirarin Eunsu, sannan ka bayyana yadda wani ɓangare na ikirarin ya karye da misalin karyatawa, ɗayan kuma ya tabbata.
y-m-50-04.material:
Akwai saituka X={1, 2}, Y={a, b, c}, Z={p, q, r}. Ayyukan f: X→Y da g: Y→Z su ne kamar haka.
f(1)=a, f(2)=b
g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p
Aikin haɗaka g∘f yana ba da g(f(x)) ga kowane abu x na X. Aiki ɗaya-da-ɗaya shi ne inda ake ba abubuwa biyu daban-daban a yankin aiki ƙimomi daban-daban koyaushe.
Ikirarin Eunsu: “Idan g∘f aiki ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya, to f da g duka ayyuka ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya.”
y-m-50-04.thinking.0: Raba ikirarin gida biyu, sannan ka tantance kowanne dabam.
y-m-50-04.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin ɓangaren da ya tabbata.
y-m-50-04.prereq.0: “H1” a wannan aiki lakabin wahala ne kawai a aikin samarwa; ba ya nufin manhajar tana koyar da wannan batu a wani aji na musamman. Abin da ake ɗauka: an san ma’anar aiki, nemo ƙimar aikin haɗaka (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)), da ma’anar aiki ɗaya-da-ɗaya (abubuwa biyu daban-daban a yankin aiki koyaushe suna samun ƙimomi daban-daban). Ba a amfani da daidaiton ɗaya-da-ɗaya ko ayyukan akasin aiki.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin g∘f kai tsaye ga f da g na sama, sannan ka zaɓi abin da wannan misali ke nuna game da ikirarin Eunsu.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo g∘f(1) da g∘f(2) dabam, sannan ka tsara su a tebur.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko akwai ƙimomi daidai a cikin ƙimomin g guda uku: g(a), g(b), g(c).
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.a: Idan g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, dole g ma ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.a: Kwatanta g(a) da g(c). Duba ko akwai yanayin da abubuwa biyu daban-daban ke samun ƙima ɗaya a wannan g.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.b: A wannan misali, g∘f ba aiki ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.b: Lissafta g(f(1)) da g(f(2)) kai tsaye, sannan ka duba ko sun yi daidai. Ka yi tunanin ko ka yanke hukunci kafin lissafawa.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.c: Ko da g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, g ba lallai ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.d: c bai bayyana cikin ƙimomin f ba, saboda haka babu bukatar la’akari da g(c) a wannan misali.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.d: Dole a binciki ko g ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne a kowane abu na yankin aiki Y na g. Ka kuma duba ƙimar da g ke bayarwa ga c, wanda bai bayyana cikin ƙimomin f ba.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.explain: g∘f(1)=g(a)=p, kuma g∘f(2)=g(b)=q; saboda haka g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne. Amma g(a)=g(c)=p, saboda haka g ba ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne. Don haka wannan misali guda ya karya ɓangaren ikirarin cewa “g ma” haka yake. Misali guda na iya karyata “koyaushe”.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, mu gina misalin karyatawa kai tsaye da lambobi. X={1, 2}, Y={1, 2, 3}, Z={1, 2, 3}, kuma f(1)=1, f(2)=2. Tantance ƙimomin g(1)=u, g(2)=v, g(3)=w (kowannensu ɗaya daga 1, 2, 3), sannan ka samar da nau’i-nau’i uku daban-daban na (u, v, w) inda g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne amma g ba ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta da furuci yadda g(f(1)) da g(f(2)) dole su kasance domin g∘f ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.hint.1: Domin g kada ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya, duba abin da ya kamata ya faru tsakanin ƙimomin u, v, w uku; sannan ka bincika dabam ko g(3) yana cikin ƙimomin g∘f.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙimomin uku duka abubuwa ne na Z.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ƙimomin g dole su kasance abubuwa na Z={1, 2, 3} (ɗaya daga 1, 2, 3).
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kwatanta g∘f(1)=g(f(1))=u da g∘f(2)=g(f(2))=v. A wannan yanayin g∘f ba ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.ok.c3: g ba aiki ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c3: u, v, w duk sun bambanta. Saboda haka g aiki ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya da ke ba da ƙimomi dabam-dabam ga shigarwa uku dabam-dabam.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.explain: Ƙimomin g∘f u da v ne kawai; idan u≠v, g∘f aiki ne ɗaya-da-ɗaya. Domin g kada ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya, dole g(3)=w ya zama u ko v. Ko da g ya maimaita ƙimar baya a 3, wadda ba ta cikin ƙimomin f, hakan ba ya shafar g∘f. Idan w ya bambanta da u da v, g ma ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya, saboda haka ba zai zama misalin ƙaryatawa ba.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.prompt: Sashen da’awar Eunsu mai cewa “idan g∘f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, to f ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne” daidai ne. Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yake daidai.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin misali ɗaya inda f ba ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne (f(1)=f(2)), ka rubuta ƙimomi biyun na g∘f.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.hint.1: Duba daga ma’anar aiki abin da g ke bayarwa idan aka saka ƙima guda ɗaya.

y-m-50-03.title: Matsarwa sannan a juya ko juya sannan a matsar: sakamakon iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-50-03.topic: Jerin sauya jadawali da nuna shi a axis x (sharadin da sakamakon zai yi daidai)
y-m-50-03.goal: Tabbatar da misalin karyatawa cewa jadawalin da aka samu na iya bambanta bisa jerin matsarwa da nuna shi a axis x; nemo da kanka yanayin da sauya jeri zai ba da jadawali iri ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana dalili ta matsayin kolo.
y-m-50-03.material:
Mu sauya jadawalin y=x² ta hanyoyi biyu.
Hanya A: Da farko a nuna shi a axis x, sannan a matsar da shi p a alkiblar x da q a alkiblar y.
Hanya B: Da farko a matsar da shi p a alkiblar x da q a alkiblar y, sannan a nuna shi a axis x.
(p tabbatacce yana nufin matsawa dama, mara kyau kuma hagu; q tabbatacce yana nufin sama, mara kyau kuma ƙasa. Nuna shi a axis x yana nufin juya shi ƙasa sama.)
Minho ya ce, “Ko da an sauya jeri, jadawalin da aka samu iri ɗaya ne koyaushe.”

Abin da ake ɗauka: an san jadawalin y=x² (parabola mai buɗewa sama, kolo a asali), matsar da maki (x, y) ta p a alkiblar x da q a alkiblar y, da nuna maki (x, y) a axis x zuwa (x, -y).
y-m-50-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙimomin gwaji (p, q) da za su iya nuna cewa maganar Minho ba daidai ba ce. (Shari’o’in da jadawalin da aka samu ta A da B suka bambanta.)

y-m-50-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa idan koòrdinatin kolo biyun sun bambanta, jadawalai ma sun bambanta.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.a: Idan p ba 0 ba ne kuma q=0, rubuta inda kololin A da B za su kasance. Duba ko kololin hanyoyin biyu sun yi daidai.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.c: Idan ba a matsar da komai ba, hanyoyin biyu suna ba da jadawalin y=x² da aka nuna a axis x. Ba za ka iya gane bambancin jerin hanyoyin da wannan ƙima ba.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.e: Idan an matsar da shi gefe kawai, sauya jeri da nuna shi a axis x ba ya kawo bambanci. Nemo kololin hanyoyin biyu dabam.

y-m-50-01.topic: Sharadin da ke sa alaƙa da aka bayyana ta furuci daban-daban a tazarori ya zama aiki (ƙimar a maki iyaka)

y-m-50-01.material: Seoa ta ƙirƙiri ƙa’idar alaƙa a kan duk lambobin gaske. (Idan x bai wuce 2 ba, y=x+3.) (Idan x ya kai 2 ko fiye, y=a sau x da aka ƙara b, wato y=ax+b.) a da b ƙimomi ne da ba a tantance ba tukuna. Seoa ta ce, “Na rubuta furucin gida biyu, saboda haka wannan aiki ne.” Yadda ake karantawa: “x≤2” na nufin “x bai wuce 2 ba”, “x≥2” kuma na nufin “x ya kai 2 ko fiye”. Idan x daidai yake da 2, layukan biyu duka suna aiki.

Yankin aiki duk lambobin gaske ne.

y-m-50-06.title: Idan muka ɗaga layi, shin yawan wuraren haɗuwa zai ci gaba da ƙaruwa?
y-m-50-06.topic: Adadin haɗuwar jadawalin aikin surd y=√(x−1)+2 da layi y=x+k (yadda adadin ke canzawa da k).
y-m-50-06.goal: Gwada tunanin cewa adadin haɗuwa yana canzawa a kai a kai yayin da layi ke matsawa alkibla guda da ƙimomi na ainihi; nemo ƙimomi da dama da suka cika sharadin, ka bayyana cewa adadin ya danganta da kewayon k.
y-m-50-06.material:
Jadawalin aikin f(x)=√(x−1)+2 (x≥1) lanƙwasa ce da ta fara a maki (1, 2), sannan tana tashi a hankali zuwa dama. (Ana karanta √ “tushen murabba’i”, √(x−1) kuma “tushen murabba’in x a cire 1”.) Misalan ƙima: f(1)=2, f(2)=3, f(5)=4, f(10)=5.
Muna motsa layi y=x+k (gangara 1, k tabbataccen lamba ne) sama da ƙasa. Seohyun ta ce, “Idan k ya ƙaru, layi yana hawa, saboda haka yawan maki da ya haɗu da jadawali zai ci gaba da ƙaruwa.”

y-m-50-06.s.s1.prompt: Duba adadin maki da layi y=x+k ya haɗu da jadawalin ga k=0, 1, 2. Zaɓi abin da za ka iya koya game da maganar Seohyun daga sakamakon.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tebur ka kwatanta ƙimomin f(x) da x+k a x=1, 2, 5, 10 ga k=0, 1, 2.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.hint.1: A teburin, nemo inda kwatancen ke canzawa tsakanin tazarar da f(x) ya fi layi da inda ya yi ƙasa da layi.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.a: Ga k=0, 1, 2, yawan haɗuwa 1, 1, 1 ne, saboda haka bai canza ba.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.a: Ga k=1, lissafa f(x) da x+1 ga x=1 da x=2 ka kwatanta. ƙimomi nawa na x suke da amsa iri ɗaya?
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.b: Ga k=0, 1, 2, yawan haɗuwa 1, 2, 0 ne, saboda haka ya ƙaru sannan ya ragu.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.c: Ga k=0, 1, 2, yawan haɗuwa 1, 2, 3 ne, yana ƙaruwa da ɗaya kowane lokaci.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.c: Ga k=2, kwatanta ƙimomin don ganin ko layi yana sama ko ƙasa da jadawali a x=1, 2, 5, 10. Duba ko akwai haɗuwa.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.d: Ga k=0, 1, 2, yawan haɗuwa 2, 1, 0 ne, saboda haka raguwa kawai yake yi.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.d: Kwatanta k=0 da k=1. Duba yadda adadin haɗuwa ya bambanta tsakanin ƙimomin biyun.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.explain: Idan k=0, layi y=x yana da f(2)=3>2 da f(5)=4<5, saboda haka ya haɗu da jadawali a maki guda tsakanin x=2 da 5. Idan k=1, f(1)=2=1+1 kuma f(2)=3=2+1, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a x=1 da x=2 (maki biyu). Idan k=2, layi kullum yana sama da jadawali kuma ba sa haɗuwa (maki 0). Don haka misalin ƙaryatawa ya rusa furucin “yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa”.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin k guda uku dabam-dabam da ke ba da haɗuwa biyu tak. Za ka iya rubuta adadi goma. (misali 1.1)
y-m-50-06.s.s2.hint.0: Yi tebur kana ƙara k kaɗan-kaɗan, don duba ko adadin haɗuwa yana canzawa wani wuri tsakanin k=1 da k=2.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi irin wannan tebur ga ƙimomin k da suka gaza 1 (0, 0.5, 0.9), ka kwatanta yawan haɗuwa.

Don samun tushen marasa kyau biyu dabam-dabam, discriminant dole ya zama 5−4k>0, samfurin tushen biyun kuma k−1≥0, saboda haka 1≤k<5/4. Idan k=5/4 suna taɓawa a maki guda; idan k<1 akwai maki guda; idan k>5/4 ba sa haɗuwa.

y-m-50-02.topic: Tantance alamomin ƙoefishan daga bayanin jadawalin aikin murabba’i y=ax²+bx+c (wadatar bayanin)
y-m-50-02.goal: Tantance wane haɗin bayanai cikin bayanan jadawali da aka bayyana da kalmomi ya isa a gane alamomin ƙoefishan, sannan ka gina ayyuka daban-daban da suka cika bayanan duka domin tabbatar da cewa bayanan kaɗai ba sa kayyade aiki guda ɗaya.
y-m-50-02.material:
Jimin ya bayyana jadawalin aikin murabba’i y=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c lambobi ne na gaske, a≠0) da kalmomi. Babu hoto. Ana karanta furucin da “y daidai yake da a ninka x murabba’i, a ƙara bx da c”.
(가) Jadawalin yana buɗewa sama (yana lanƙwasawa ƙasa).
(나) Koòrdinatin y na wurin haɗuwarsa da axis y ita ce 3.
(다) Kolo yana hannun dama na axis y. (Koòrdinatin x na kolo tabbatacciya ce.)
(라) Yana haɗuwa da axis x a maki biyu daban-daban.

Abin da ake ɗauka: an riga an san cewa jadawalin aikin murabba’i y=ax²+bx+c parabola ce, alamar a ce ke tantance alkiblar buɗewa, koòrdinatin x na kolo ita ce -b/(2a) (ko yadda ake mayar da shi sigar y=a(x-p)²+q), da alaƙar yawan maki haɗuwa da axis x da alamar discriminant b²-4ac.

y-m-50-08.title: Lissafin Eunji kan yawan maki haɗuwa: wane layi ne bai dace ba?
y-m-50-08.topic: Yawan maki haɗuwar jadawalin y=|x²-2x-3| da layi kwance y=m (rarrabewa bisa zangon m)
y-m-50-08.goal: Nemo layin da bai dace ba a lissafin da ya duba yawan maki haɗuwar jadawalin aikin murabba’i mai cikakkiyar ƙima da layi kwance bisa zangon m; duba ta saka ƙima kai tsaye, sannan ka gyara.
y-m-50-08.material: Wannan shi ne lissafin Eunji don nemo yawan maki haɗuwar jadawalin aikin f(x)=|x²-2x-3| da layi kwance y=m (m ƙima ce ta dindindin). (Ana karanta |a| da “cikakkiyar ƙimar a”.) Babu hoto.
y-m-50-08.thinking.0: Nemo layin da bai dace ba a lissafin.
y-m-50-08.thinking.1: Duba kai tsaye ta saka ƙimomi.
y-m-50-08.thinking.2: Tsara ta hanyar raba bisa zangon ƙima.
y-m-50-08.prereq.0: “H1” a wannan aiki lakabin wahala ne kawai a aikin samarwa, ba ya nufin manhaja tana koyar da batu a wani aji. Abin da ake ɗauka: an san jadawalin aikin murabba’i (kolo, wuraren haɗuwa da axis x), ma’anar alamar cikakkiyar ƙima (|a| yana daidaita da -a idan a mara kyau ne), cewa jadawalin y=|f(x)| jadawalin y=f(x) ne inda aka naɗe ɓangaren ƙasa da axis x zuwa sama, da kuma yadda ake warware ma’aunin murabba’i.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda ɗaya marar daidai a lissafin Eunji. (An nuna lambobin layukan tun daga 1.)
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.0: Idan m=4, duba ko akwai wuri a rassan waje (x>3, x<-1), ba ɓangaren da aka naɗe ba, inda y ya zama 4.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafta ƙimomin f(x) idan x=3 da x=4, sannan ka duba ko 4 yana tsakaninsu.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.0: x²-2x-3=(x-3)(x+1), saboda haka jadawalin y=x²-2x-3 yana haɗuwa da axis x idan x=-1 da x=3; kolo kuma shi ne (1, -4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.1: Saboda cikakkiyar ƙima, ɓangaren da yake ƙasa da axis x (-1<x<3) an naɗe shi sama da axis. Ƙolin wannan ɓangaren shi ne (1, 4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.2: Idan m=4 ne, suna haɗuwa ne kawai a ƙolin ɓangaren da aka naɗe, (1, 4); saboda haka haɗuwa guda 1 ce.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.3: Idan 0<m<4 ne, yana haɗuwa da ɓangaren da aka naɗe a maki biyu, da kuma kowane rassan waje a maki guda; saboda haka haɗuwa 4 ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.4: Idan m>4 ne, ba ya taɓa ɓangaren da aka naɗe, yana haɗuwa da kowane rassan waje a maki guda; saboda haka haɗuwa 2 ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.5: Idan m=0 ne, yana haɗuwa a maki biyu na axis x, x=-1 da x=3; saboda haka haɗuwa 2 ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 bai dace ba. Daidai ne cewa idan m=4 suna haɗuwa a saman ɓangaren da aka naɗe (1, 4), amma rassan waje biyun ma suna wucewa ta y=4. Misali, ƙimar y ita ce 0 idan x=3, 5 kuma idan x=4, saboda haka ta wuce y=4 tsakaninsu (x=1+2√2). A wancan gefen ma haka yake, don haka jimilla haɗuwa 3 ne. Layuka na 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 daidai ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.prompt: Samar da ƙimomin m uku daban-daban da suke da maki haɗuwa 4 daidai. Za a iya rubuta adadi mai digo.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi ƙima mai sauƙi kamar m=1 ko 2, sannan ka ƙidaya maki haɗuwarsa a ɓangaren da aka naɗe da rassan waje.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yayin da m ke ƙaruwa, nemo ƙimar farko da yawan maki haɗuwa ke sauyawa.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Layi kwance ne a saman axis x.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan m bai wuce 0 ba, ba zai yiwu a sami haɗuwa huɗu ba. (Idan m mara kyau ne babu haɗuwa; idan 0 ne maki na axis x ne.)
y-m-50-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Layi kwance ne a ƙasa da ƙolin ɓangaren da aka naɗe.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan m ya kai 4 ko ya fi, yawan maki haɗuwa da ɓangaren da aka naɗe yana raguwa. Kwatanta da tsayin ƙolin ɓangaren da aka naɗe.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ka sa m ya kasance tsakanin -10 da 10.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.explain: Idan 0<m<4 ne, akwai maki biyu a ɓangaren da aka naɗe da maki ɗaya a kowane rassan waje; jimilla 4. Idan m=0, maki 2 ne; m=4, 3 ne; m>4, 2 ne; m<0, 0 ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta yadda za a tabbatar da ma’aunai cewa akwai haɗuwa 3 idan m=4. (Warware |x²-2x-3|=4 ta raba zuwa shari’o’i biyu.)
y-m-50-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ƙimomi biyun da furuci na ciki dole ya samu domin cikakkiyar ƙimarsa ta zama 4.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙidaya adadin mafita na kowace ma’aunin murabba’i (ta discriminant ko warwarewa zuwa abubuwa).
y-m-50-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙidaya mafitar x a kowane shari’a, sannan ka haɗa su?
y-m-50-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar cewa shari’a ɗaya tana da mafita biyu, ɗayar kuma mafita ɗaya (tushen da ya maimaitu)?
y-m-50-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka duba ko x ɗin da ka samo ba su yi daidai da juna ba?
y-m-50-08.s.s3.model.0: Idan x²-2x-3=4, to x²-2x-7=0; saboda haka x=1±2√2, mafita biyu ne. Idan x²-2x-3=-4, to (x-1)²=0, saboda haka x=1, mafita ɗaya ce. Jimilla 3 ne.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.model.1: |x²-2x-3|=4 yana nufin x²-2x-3=4 ko x²-2x-3=-4. Na farkon tana da discriminant 32, tabbatacce ne, saboda haka tana da tushen gaske biyu daban-daban; na biyu kuma tana da tushe ɗaya da ya maimaitu. Jimilla 3 ne, kuma ƙimomin sun bambanta.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta ƙidaya ta amfani da discriminant.

y-m-50-05.title: Asimptot biyu da maki guda: shin jadawali ya kayyade?
y-m-50-05.topic: Bayanin da ake buƙata don kayyade jadawalin aikin rational y=a+k/(x-p) (asimptot da maki da jadawali ya ratsa).
y-m-50-05.goal: Yanke hukunci cewa asimptot kaɗai ba sa kayyade aiki rational guda, ƙara maki da jadawali ya ratsa yana kayyade shi, kuma ƙarin sharudda na iya karo da juna; sake duba ko riƙe hukuncinka, sannan da kanka ka zaɓi wanne daga sharuddan da suka karo za ka yi shakku a kansa.
y-m-50-05.material: Bayanin jadawalin aiki rational guda yana zuwa ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Babu hoto. Furuci kamar “y daidai da 3 ƙari k bisa (x a cire 2)” ana karanta haka. Asimptot layi ne da jadawali ke matsowa kusa da shi har abada amma ba ya taɓa shi.
y-m-50-05.thinking.0: Sake duba hukunci yayin da bayani ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-50-05.thinking.1: Duba ko sharudda sun saɓa wa juna.
y-m-50-05.thinking.2: Kwatanta ka tantance wanne sharadi za a yi shakku a kansa.
y-m-50-05.prereq.0: “H1” a wannan aiki alamar wahala ce kawai a samarwa kuma ba ta nufin manhaja ta ware abun ga wani aji ba. Sharadi: a ɗauka ka san cewa jadawalin aikin rational y=k/(x-p)+q (k≠0) yana da layukan x=p da y=q a matsayin asimptot biyu, da yadda ake saka coordinates na maki cikin furuci domin daidaita ƙima.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanin ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci yanke hukunci bisa bayanin yanzu, sabon bayani idan ya zo ka yanke ko za ka riƙe ko gyara hukuncinka.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.0: Saka kowane bayani cikin furuci ka ƙirga adadin abubuwan da ba a sani ba da suka rage.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.1: Saka sabon bayanin cikin furucin da ka samu a baya, ka lissafa kai tsaye ko ya dace.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Abin da aka sani game da jadawalin aikin rational shi ne asimptot a tsaye layi x=2 ne, asimptot a kwance kuma layi y=3 ne. Wannan aikin yana da sifar y=3+k/(x−2) (k tabbataccen marar sifili ne).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shin wannan bayanin kaɗai ya kayyade aikin zuwa guda ɗaya?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Ko k=2, 5 ko −3, asimptot iri ɗaya ne, x=2 da y=3. Asimptot ɗin suna nuna “tsarin” wurin da jadawali yake, ba sa nuna k (yadda jadawali ke lanƙwasawa da yankunan da yake ciki).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: An kayyade. An ba da asimptot biyu, saboda haka k ma an kayyade.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ko k=2 ko 5, asimptot iri ɗaya ne, x=2 da y=3. Duba ko za ka iya sanin ƙimar k ta kallon asimptot kaɗai.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba a kayyade ba. Jadawali masu ƙimomin k dabam-dabam duk suna da waɗannan asimptot.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba a kayyade ba. Ana buƙatar ƙarin asimptot guda.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Aiki rational mai wannan sifa yana da asimptot biyu tak. Abin da ya ɓace ba yawan asimptot ba ne, wani irin bayani ne da zai kayyade k.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon bayani: wannan jadawali yana ratsa maki (0, 1).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Saka x=0, y=1 yana ba da 1=3+k/(0−2)=3−k/2, saboda haka k=4. An kayyade jadawalin a matsayin y=3+4/(x−2), wato y=(3x−2)/(x−2).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lokacin saka x=0, y=1 cikin furuci, duba ka saka x=0 cikin x−2 yayin lissafi. Wataƙila alama ta juye.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Har yanzu ba a kayyade ba.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Saka maki guda cikin furuci yana ƙirƙirar ma’auni guda a k. Yi tunani ko ma’aunin yana da mafita guda.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Ƙarin bayani: wannan jadawali ma yana ratsa maki (4, 6). Amma idan aka saka x=4 cikin y=3+4/(x−2) da aka samu a baya, y=5 ne.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya za ka ɗauki wannan sabon bayani?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan aka riƙe asimptot y=3 yadda yake, babu jadawali da zai ratsa maki biyun. Idan aka bar asimptot a kwance a matsayin y=a, a=3.5, k=5 yana ba da jadawali da ke ratsa biyun. Ya kamata a yanke wane bayani za a amince da shi bisa tushen bayanin da ko za a iya tabbatar da shi.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sake sa k=6 ka manta da maki na baya (0, 1).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan k=6, to y=0 a x=0, wanda ya saɓa da maki (0, 1) da aka bayar a baya. Yi tunani ko akwai dalilin watsi da tsohon bayani.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tunda sharuddan (asimptot biyu da maki biyun) ba sa iya tabbata gaba ɗaya, dole ne a bincika wanne sharadi ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wataƙila an sanar da bayanin maki (4, 6) ba daidai ba, saboda haka a riƙe k=4 har sai an tabbatar.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Amince da asimptot a tsaye x=2 amma yi tunanin cewa asimptot a kwance ba y=3 ba ne, sannan sake nemo shi.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.reflect: Duba tsarin binciken kai tsaye da sabon bayani duk lokacin da bayanai suka ƙaru: “har yanzu hukuncin baya daidai ne?” Ka kuma tabbatar akwai dalilai masu yiwuwa da dama idan bayanai suka saɓa wa juna.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.prompt: Mu nemo aikin rational y=a+k/(x−2) da ke ratsa maki (0, 1) da (4, 6), kuma yana da asimptot a tsaye x=2. A wannan karon kada ka kayyade asimptot a kwance a matsayin y=3; ɗauki a a matsayin abin da ba a sani ba ma. Shigar da yiwuwar biyun (a, k).
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka (0, 1) domin rubuta dangantaka tsakanin a da k, sannan saka (4, 6) don rubuta dangantaka ta biyu.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunani nawa ne (a, k) suke cika dangantakokin biyun tare.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan k=0, wannan ba aikin rational ba ne. Yi amfani da lambar da ba sifili ba.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c2: y ba ya zama 1 idan x=0. Saka (0, 1) cikin furuci don dubawa.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c3: y ba ya zama 6 idan x=4. Saka (4, 6) cikin furuci don dubawa.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.explain: Saka maki biyun yana ba da a−k/2=1 da a+k/2=6; haɗawa yana ba da 2a=7, a=3.5, sannan cirewa yana ba da k=5. y=3.5+5/(x−2), mai asimptot a kwance y=3.5, yana ratsa maki biyun. Da waɗannan sharudda mafita guda ɗaya ce.

y-m-50-07.title: Idan bango ya yi tsawo, shin alkalamin zai yi girma kullum?
y-m-50-07.topic: Takaita yankin aikin a matsalar mafi girman ƙimar aikin quadratic (ko vertex yana cikin tazara ko wajen ta).
y-m-50-07.goal: Yanke hukunci bisa sharadin yankin ko mafi girman ƙimar aikin quadratic tana vertex ko ƙarshen tazara; sake duba ko riƙe hukunci idan sharadi ya canza, sannan ka yi tebur na mafi girma ga kowane sharadi da kanka.
y-m-50-07.material: Muna gina katangar alƙalami mai siffar murabba’i da igiya mai tsawon 20 m. An jingina gefe guda da bango madaidaici, ba a sa igiya a wannan gefen ba. Idan tsawon gefen da ke bango (mai daidaito da bango) x m ne, tsawon gefen da yake tsaye gare shi kuma y m ne, to x+2y=20, kuma yankin A=xy (㎡, murabba’in mita) shi ne A=x(20−x)/2. x ya fi 0 kuma ya gaza 20. Tsawon gefen bango x ba zai wuce tsawon bangon ba. [lambobi: 2, 20]
y-m-50-07.thinking.0: Sake duba hukunci yayin da sharudda ke canzawa.
y-m-50-07.thinking.1: Bambanta matsayin da mafi girman ƙima ke faruwa (vertex ko ƙarshen tazara).
y-m-50-07.thinking.2: Tsara sakamako ga kowane sharadi a tebur.
y-m-50-07.prereq.0: “H1” a wannan aiki alamar wahala ce kawai a samarwa kuma ba ta nufin manhaja ta ware abun ga wani aji ba. Sharadi: a ɗauka ka san vertex na aikin quadratic da nemo mafi girma a kewayon da aka takaita (ta siffar jadawali), da kafa furuci ta sanya tsawon gefe a matsayin harafi.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da bayanin tsawon bango ya canza, yanke hukunci kan x da ke sa alƙalami ya fi girma; idan sabon bayani ya zo yanke ko a riƙe ko a gyara hukuncin.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.0: Yi ƙaramin tebur na ƙimomin x da A, ka nemo inda ya fi girma.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko x da ya ba da mafi girman ƙima a tebur yana cikin halastaccen kewayon x.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Bango yana da tsawo ƙwarai, babu iyaka ga x. (0<x<20)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane x ne ke ba da yankin mafi girma?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.after: A(5)=37.5, A(10)=50, A(15)=37.5. Jadawalin A=x(20−x)/2 parabola ce mai buɗe ƙasa, vertex a x=10, saboda haka mafi girma 50㎡ yana a x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: A(5)=5×15/2=37.5. Lissafa ƙima guda don kwatanta abin da ke faruwa ga yankin idan x ya wuce 5.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A(15)=15×5/2=37.5. Lissafa ka kwatanta ko ya gaza ƙimar a 10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka gano tsawon bangon 8 m ne. (x bai wuce 8 ba)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu wane x ne ke sa alƙalami ya fi girma?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Halastaccen kewayon shi ne 0<x≤8, kuma vertex x=10 yana wajen kewayon. Cikin kewayon, A yana ƙaruwa yayin da x ya ƙaru, saboda haka mafi girma yana ƙarshen kewayo x=8, inda A=8×12/2=48 (㎡).
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: x=10 ya fi bango tsawon 2 m, saboda haka ba zai jingina da bango ba. Duba yadda A ke canzawa cikin kewayon x da aka yarda.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Cikin kewayon x≤8, lissafa ko A yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa yayin tafiya daga x=5 zuwa 8.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.info: An matsar da bango zuwa wuri mafi tsawo, yanzu tsawonsa 12 m. (x bai wuce 12 ba)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane x ne ke sa alƙalami ya fi girma?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Halastaccen kewayon shi ne 0<x≤12, vertex x=10 yana ciki. Mafi girma 50㎡ yana a vertex; a ƙarshen bango x=12, 48㎡ ne, ya fi ƙasa. Yin amfani da bangon har ƙarshe ba koyaushe ne mafi kyau ba.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan ka yi amfani da bango har ƙarshensa, A(12)=12×8/2=48. Kwatanta da ƙimar x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.reflect: Ya danganta da tsawon bango, mafi girma wani lokaci yana “vertex”, wani lokaci kuma “ƙarshen kewayon”. Duba abin da ka bincika a sabon salo lokacin da ka gyara hukunci.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.prompt: Yi tebur na mafi girman yankin A (㎡) da za ka iya ginawa idan tsawon bango w m ne (0<w≤20). Shigar da biyun (w, A) guda uku masu yankin mafi girma dabam-dabam.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi w, rubuta halastaccen kewayon x, sannan nemo inda A ya fi girma cikin kewayon.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.1: Canza w zuwa 4, 8, 12 da makamantansu, ka kwatanta yadda x mai ba da mafi girma ya bambanta.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka riƙe w fiye da 0 kuma bai wuce 20 ba.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Wannan shi ne yankin mafi girma da za a iya ginawa da wannan bango.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Wannan ba shi ne mafi girman yankin da za a iya ginawa da wannan w ba. Sake nemo inda A ya fi girma cikin halastaccen kewayon x.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.explain: Idan w≤10, mafi girma yana ƙarshen halastaccen x, w; idan w≥10, yana vertex x=10. Misali, w=4 yana ba da 32, w=8 yana ba da 48, w=10 yana ba da 50, w=15 kuma 50 (㎡). Idan w≥10 ne, tsawon bango dabam-dabam na iya ba da yanki iri ɗaya.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.prompt: Yanke hukunci ko furucin “Idan bango ya fi tsawo, alƙalami da za a gina zai fi girma” daidai ne kullum, ka yi bayani da lambobin tebur ɗin a matsayin shaida.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bi daga farko zuwa ƙarshe yadda ƙimar A ta canza yayin da w ke ƙaruwa a teburin da ka yi.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo ƙimar w inda A ya daina ƙaruwa.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan bango ya kai 8 m, ..., idan ya kai 15 m, ...
y-m-50-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yi bayani dabam kan lokacin da bango gajere ne da lokacin da yake tsawo?
y-m-50-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana tsawon iyakar bango (10 m) da lamba?
y-m-50-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka sake lissafa A kai tsaye a misalan lambobinka?
y-m-50-07.s.s3.model.0: Idan bangon 8 m ne, matsakaicin fili 48㎡ ne; idan 12 m ne, 50㎡ ne, kuma ko da a 15 m ɗin nan 50㎡ yake. Har zuwa 10 m, tsawon bango yana ƙara fili, amma bayan haka tsawaitawa ba ya taimaka, saboda haka “koyaushe” ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.model.1: Ba daidai ba ne koyaushe. Bango 4 m yana ba da 32㎡, 8 m kuma 48㎡, ana ƙaruwa; amma daga 10 m zuwa sama fili yana nan 50㎡. Kolon yana a x=10, saboda haka ko bango ya fi wannan tsawo, filin ba ya ƙaruwa.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta bayar da matsayin kolo a matsayin dalili.
